name: COODU AI
line: India-first AI company. Built the whole front door before the first model shipped.
problem: A brand-new AI company with no public presence, no narrative, and a founder-shaped bottleneck on everything.
approach: Next.js + GSAP marketing site with a scroll-driven story, plus a structured founder knowledge base for vision, roadmap and pillar docs.

name: HELM
line: A business operating system. Six modules that refuse to be six spreadsheets.
problem: Small businesses run on a dozen disconnected sheets and WhatsApp threads. Nothing reconciles, nothing is auditable.
approach: One FastAPI backend, six domain modules behind a shared auth and data layer, containerised with Docker for one-command deploy.

name: HERALD
line: Email in, WhatsApp out. A concierge that reads your inbox so you don't have to.
problem: The important email always arrives while you're nowhere near an inbox — and buried under forty that aren't.
approach: Python service that ingests mail, classifies and summarises it, then pushes only what matters to WhatsApp as an actionable thread.

name: SITE ATTENDANCE
line: Face-recognition attendance for real construction sites. Dust, glare and all.
problem: Paper muster rolls on remote sites: unverifiable, slow to reconcile, and trivially gamed.
approach: On-site face onboarding and 1:N matching pipeline with a supervisor review step, built to survive bad light and worse networks.

name: COODU TRUST
line: A donation platform where the money actually has to arrive.
problem: Non-profit donation flows break in the least forgiving place possible: at the payment step, on a stranger's phone.
approach: Rebuilt the front end and hardened the donation path end to end — environment-driven endpoints, no hardcoded hosts, deployable on shared hosting.

name: TOPROCK PORTAL
line: Turned a creative team's spreadsheet sprawl into a dashboard they'll open twice a day.
problem: Creative pipeline status lived in a Google Sheet nobody trusted and everybody edited.
approach: Read-through dashboard on the Sheets API with OAuth, so the sheet stays the source of truth while the team gets a real interface.
